description: Plan v7 section 8.3 raw-vs-tagged clause, alternatives-expression half. Two keys whose single alternative compares a caller placeholder against a GENDER_* language-form literal and against a numeric literal, each with a default translation. The default is now actually exercised: fall-through cases supply a tagged form and a tagged integer that do NOT satisfy the alternative, so the positive controls prove discrimination rather than unconditional matching. Exists so the corpus pins that a raw string is never lifted to the constant the expression names, nor coerced to the number it spells.

GenderAlternative.commentary: Reached when the alternative does not match; distinct text from the branch so a match and a fall-through are never confusable.
